instruction: Navigate to the Virginia DMV page that explains the process for renewing a driver's license.

metadata.explanation: Task variation requires navigating to the license renewal page on Virginia DMV website. Maintains similar difficulty to original task (simple navigation to specific information page). Reuses existing Chrome evaluator infrastructure without needing custom functions.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirement
Getter (get_active_url_from_accessTree) correctly extracts active tab URL from accessibility tree
Metric (is_expected_active_tab) correctly compares URLs using compare_urls function
Expected URL (https://www.dmv.virginia.gov/licenses-ids/license/renew) is semantically correct - it's the actual Virginia DMV license renewal page
Complete coverage: instruction has one requirement (navigate to renewal page), evaluator checks this requirement
Data flow is correct: getter returns string URL, metric accepts string URL or dict with 'url' field
State accessibility is good: no UI state dependencies, no postconfig needed
Rule parameter handling is correct: metric directly accesses rule['type'] and rule['url']
